---
title: Basic
---

"External" demos let you write demo code in dedicated files: the MDX stays
readable, and your IDE treats the demo as the source file it is.

Point a fenced block at one with `file=`, and add `live`:

````
```tsx file="./snippets/basic/Basic.tsx" live
```
````

Which turns into:

<code src="./snippets/basic/Basic.tsx" />

The fence body stays empty — the file's contents are what gets shown. See
[Usage](../usage#path-prefixes) for the path prefixes `file=` accepts.
